name: Kashi, Gaya, Prayag & Ayodhya
summary: A six-day journey through sacred river ghats, temples and the Buddhist heritage of Sarnath and Bodh Gaya.

days.title: Arrive in Prayagraj
days.description: Arrive around noon, have lunch and visit Nishadraj Park. Stay overnight in Prayagraj.

days.title: Prayagraj to Ayodhya
days.description: Visit Triveni Sangam and Bade Hanuman Temple before travelling to Ayodhya.

days.title: Ayodhya to Varanasi
days.description: Visit Shri Ram Temple, Hanuman Garhi, Kanak Bhavan and Nageshwarnath Temple. Continue to Varanasi after lunch.

days.title: Varanasi temples and ghats
days.description: Visit Kashi Vishwanath, Kal Bhairav and Sakshi Vinayak temples. Explore Namo Ghat and the river ghats, with an evening Ganga Aarti boat experience.

days.title: Varanasi to Gaya via Sarnath
days.description: After breakfast, travel towards Gaya with a visit to Sarnath along the way.

days.title: Gaya, Bodh Gaya and Patna drop
days.description: Visit Vishnupad Temple, the Mahabodhi area, lotus tank and Jagannath Temple. Continue to Patna after lunch for your onward journey.

includes: One litre of drinking water each day
excludes: Ropeways, boating and jungle safari charges unless confirmed
notes: The tour outline lists onward departures from Patna after 9 pm; confirm your arrival and departure arrangements with the team.
The itinerary mentions a boat experience while the exclusions list boating charges. Ask the team to confirm its inclusion.

name: Shimla, Kullu & Manali
summary: Eight days of hill towns, Himalayan views and time to explore Shimla and Manali.

days.title: Delhi to Chandigarh
days.description: Meet at Delhi airport or railway station in the morning and travel to Chandigarh. Overnight in Chandigarh.

days.title: Chandigarh to Shimla
days.description: Visit Rock Garden and Sukhna Lake before travelling to Shimla.

days.title: Kufri and Shimla
days.description: Explore Kufri and Fagu Valley, then spend the evening around the Mall and the Ridge.

days.title: Shimla to Manali
days.description: Travel to Manali, stopping at a Kullu shawl factory en route. Evening at leisure.

days.title: Manali sightseeing
days.description: Visit Hadimba Temple, Manu Temple and Club House, with time around the Mall.

days.title: Atal Tunnel and Solang Valley
days.description: Explore the Atal Tunnel area, Solang Valley and a snow point when access and conditions permit.

days.title: Manali to Chandigarh via Kullu
days.description: Travel through Kullu, with optional river rafting at additional cost, and continue to Chandigarh.

days.title: Chandigarh to Delhi
days.description: Return to Delhi for your onward flight or train.

includes: One litre of drinking water each day
notes: Atal Tunnel, snow points and mountain roads depend on weather and local operating conditions.

name: Darjeeling, Gangtok & Pelling
summary: An eight-day eastern Himalayan circuit of monasteries, mountain viewpoints and tea country.

days.title: Bagdogra to Gangtok
days.description: Arrive at Bagdogra, with a suggested morning arrival, and transfer to Gangtok.

days.title: Gangtok sightseeing
days.description: Explore Banjhakri Falls, the Institute of Tibetology, Ganesh Tok, viewpoints and local craft attractions.

days.title: Tsomgo Lake and Baba Mandir
days.description: Visit Tsomgo Lake and Baba Mandir. A Nathu La excursion depends on permits and access.

days.title: Gangtok to Pelling via Namchi
days.description: Visit the Char Dham temple complex and Buddha Park on the journey to Pelling.

days.title: Pelling sightseeing
days.description: Explore the Skywalk, Rabdentse ruins and Pemayangtse Monastery.

days.title: Pelling to Darjeeling
days.description: Travel to Darjeeling. An optional toy-train ride to Ghoom can be discussed with the team.

days.title: Darjeeling viewpoints and tea country
days.description: Make an early visit to Tiger Hill, weather permitting, followed by Ghoom Monastery, Batasia Loop, the Himalayan Mountaineering Institute and tea-estate sights.

days.title: Darjeeling to Bagdogra
days.description: Return to Bagdogra for your onward flight. Confirm flight timing before booking.

includes: One litre of drinking water each day
excludes: Ropeways, boating, safari and optional toy-train charges
notes: Nathu La requires permission; mountain viewpoints depend on clear weather.
Hotel category and room arrangements are not specified in the tour outline inclusion list and must be confirmed.

name: Kashmir, Amritsar & Vaishno Devi
summary: A ten-day route combining Amritsar and Vaishno Devi with the valleys and lakes of Kashmir.
includes: One-hour Shikara ride on Dal Lake
Jeep charges for Aru Valley in Pahalgam
One litre of drinking water each day
excludes: Pony or jeep activities at Sonmarg
notes: The tour outline specifies 10 days but does not include a daily itinerary. Request the confirmed day-by-day plan on WhatsApp.
highlights: Amritsar: Golden Temple, Jallianwala Bagh and the Attari–Wagah border
Srinagar: Mughal gardens, Dal Lake and Shankaracharya Hill
Gulmarg: mountain scenery and a gondola excursion to discuss with the team
Pahalgam: Betaab Valley and Aru Valley

name: Pithapur & Kuravpur Yatra
summary: An eight-day pilgrimage from Pune through Kuravpur, Srisailam and Pithapuram.

days.title: Pune to Raichur and Kuravpur
days.description: Travel overnight by train from Pune to Raichur. After arrival and lunch, visit Kuravpur for Shripad Shri Vallabha darshan.

days.title: Raichur to Srisailam
days.description: Travel to Srisailam and stay overnight.

days.title: Akka Mahadevi Cave and Mallikarjuna
days.description: Visit the Kardalivan foothill area up to Akka Mahadevi Cave, then Mallikarjuna Jyotirlinga Temple. Stay in Srisailam.

days.title: Srisailam to Vijayawada
days.description: Continue to Vijayawada after breakfast and stay overnight.

days.title: Vijayawada to Kakinada
days.description: Travel to Kakinada and visit Pithapuram for the Palkhi ceremony.

days.title: Pithapuram and Annavaram
days.description: Visit Pithapuram for darshan and continue to Annavaram after lunch. Stay in Kakinada.

days.title: Return train journey
days.description: Depart from Kakinada by train. Confirm the current service and timetable with the team.

days.title: Arrive in Pune
days.description: Return to Pune, where the yatra concludes.

includes: Internal transfers and sightseeing by air-conditioned vehicle, with smaller vehicles or boats where needed
Vegetarian breakfast, lunch and dinner on days 1–6; packed breakfast on day 7
Tour escort from Pune to Pune
Daily drinking water on days 1–7, except infants
Porter charges except at Pune and Mumbai
notes: Train numbers and times in the tour outline require reconfirmation before travel.
Tax treatment and the final total will be confirmed in your quotation.

name: Dubai & Abu Dhabi
summary: Six days of city landmarks, a desert safari and an Abu Dhabi excursion, with five nights in Dubai.

days.title: Mumbai to Dubai
days.description: Meet the team at Mumbai International Airport, fly to the UAE and transfer to your Dubai hotel.

days.title: Dubai landmarks
days.description: Explore Jumeirah Beach and city photo stops, Dubai Frame and the Museum of the Future exterior. Visit Dubai Mall and Burj Khalifa’s 124th floor.

days.title: Desert safari
days.description: Set out for a four-wheel-drive desert safari followed by an evening programme and dinner.

days.title: Abu Dhabi and dhow cruise
days.description: Visit Sheikh Zayed Grand Mosque and Abu Dhabi city sights, with a Ferrari World photo stop. Enjoy an evening dhow cruise with dinner.

days.title: The Palm, Miracle Garden and Global Village
days.description: Visit The View at The Palm, followed by Miracle Garden and Global Village when operating.

days.title: Limousine ride, shopping and departure
days.description: Enjoy a limousine ride and time at Mina Bazaar before transferring to the airport.

includes: Mumbai–UAE return economy airfare as specified in the final plan
Visa and OTB charges for the tour
Five nights in a four-star or similar hotel
Five breakfasts, five lunches and five dinners
Airport transfers and listed sightseeing tickets
Listed parking, permits and Dubai tourism charges
excludes: Changes caused by weather, transport disruption or emergencies
Items not specified in your confirmed quotation
Applicable taxes as confirmed in your quotation
notes: Seasonal attractions, flight airport, fountain show and cruise arrangements require confirmation for your travel dates.
Museum of the Future and Ferrari World are photo stops, not entry visits.

name: Nepal
summary: Eight days linking Kathmandu’s sacred sites, Pokhara’s lakes and Chitwan’s jungle experiences.

days.title: Mumbai to Kathmandu
days.description: Fly from Mumbai, transfer to the hotel and settle in.

days.title: Kathmandu to Pokhara
days.description: Travel to Pokhara, with a cable-car visit to Manakamana Temple along the way.

days.title: Pokhara sightseeing
days.description: Enjoy Phewa Lake and Barahi Temple, then visit Bindhyabasini Temple, Seti Gorge, Davis Falls and Gupteshwar Cave.

days.title: Pokhara to Chitwan
days.description: Travel to Chitwan and enjoy a Tharu cultural show in the evening.

days.title: Chitwan jungle experiences
days.description: The source lists a safari, canoeing on the Rapti River, a jungle walk and a breeding-centre visit. Confirm the activity arrangements with the team.

days.title: Chitwan to Kathmandu
days.description: Return to Kathmandu and visit Pashupatinath Temple.

days.title: Kathmandu valley
days.description: Visit Budhanilkantha, Swayambhunath and Bhaktapur. An optional mountain flight is available at additional cost.

days.title: Kathmandu to Mumbai
days.description: Transfer to the airport for your return flight.

includes: Three nights in Kathmandu, two in Pokhara and two in Chitwan in three-/four-star or similar hotels
Meals as listed in the itinerary
Manakamana cable car and Phewa Lake boat ticket
Listed Chitwan activities and cultural show
excludes: Changes caused by weather, transport disruption or emergencies
Items not specified in your confirmed quotation
Applicable taxes as confirmed in your quotation
notes: The tour outline specifies an elephant safari. Confirm the current safari format and activity choices with the team.

name: Sri Lanka
summary: Eight days through Colombo, the cultural triangle, hill-country tea estates and Bentota’s coast.

days.title: Mumbai to Colombo
days.description: Fly to Colombo, transfer to the hotel and explore the city as arrival timing allows.

days.title: Colombo to Dambulla
days.description: Visit Pinnawala and the Dambulla Cave and Golden Temple area en route to Dambulla.

days.title: Sigiriya and Kandy
days.description: Explore the Sigiriya area before continuing to Kandy, with a cultural show and Temple of the Tooth visit.

days.title: Kandy to Nuwara Eliya
days.description: Travel through Ramboda, visiting the Hanuman Temple, waterfall and a tea factory.

days.title: Nuwara Eliya sightseeing
days.description: Visit Sita Amman Temple, Hakgala Botanical Garden and Gregory Lake.

days.title: Hill country to Bentota
days.description: Travel through tea country and waterfall viewpoints towards Bentota. Optional rafting at Kitulgala is at additional cost.

days.title: Bentota coast
days.description: Enjoy a Madu River boat ride and a turtle-hatchery visit. Water sports are optional and charged separately.

days.title: Colombo and departure
days.description: Return towards Colombo, with time for city sights and shopping before the airport drop.

includes: Meals as specified in the itinerary
Listed sightseeing entry fees, subject to the exclusions
Tour manager and English-speaking local guide
Travel kit and insurance for ages 1–59
excludes: Changes caused by weather, transport disruption or emergencies
Items not specified in your confirmed quotation
Applicable taxes as confirmed in your quotation
notes: Sigiriya Fort and water sports appear in sightseeing descriptions but are separately excluded in the tour outline. Confirm your selected activities and their costs.

name: Kerala & Kanyakumari
summary: Nine days of temple towns, backwaters, spice gardens and Munnar’s tea-covered hills.

days.title: Kochi to Guruvayur
days.description: Arrive at Kochi and travel to Guruvayur for a visit to Shri Krishna Temple.

days.title: Guruvayur, Kaladi and Kochi
days.description: Visit Kaladi, then explore Mattancherry, St Francis Church and Dutch Palace in Kochi.

days.title: Kochi to Thiruvananthapuram
days.description: Travel via the Kumarakom area and spend the evening at Kovalam Beach.

days.title: Kanyakumari excursion
days.description: Visit Vivekananda Rock Memorial, Kanyakumari Temple, the sea confluence, Gandhi Mandapam and the wax museum. Return to Thiruvananthapuram.

days.title: Thiruvananthapuram to Alappuzha
days.description: Visit Padmanabhaswamy Temple, then continue to Alappuzha for a backwater boat ride.

days.title: Alappuzha to Thekkady
days.description: Explore spice-growing country and enjoy a Kathakali show. An Ayurvedic massage is optional at additional cost.

days.title: Thekkady to Munnar
days.description: Travel through the hills to Munnar and visit Eravikulam National Park, subject to access.

days.title: Munnar sightseeing
days.description: Explore tea plantations, gardens, the Tea Museum and a chocolate factory.

days.title: Munnar to Kochi
days.description: Return to Kochi Airport for your onward journey.

includes: Return economy airfare and airport taxes as confirmed
One litre of drinking water each day
Transfers and sightseeing by coach or car as specified
Mattancherry boat ride and backwater Shikara ride
excludes: Changes caused by weather, transport disruption or emergencies
Items not specified in your confirmed quotation
Applicable taxes as confirmed in your quotation
notes: National park access and sightseeing arrangements depend on operating conditions.

name: Royal Bhutan
summary: Eight days through Bhutan’s valleys, monasteries and mountain passes, starting and ending at Bagdogra.

days.title: Bagdogra to Phuentsholing
days.description: Arrive at Bagdogra and travel to Phuentsholing. Evening at leisure.

days.title: Phuentsholing to Thimphu
days.description: Complete the permit process and travel to Thimphu via Gedu and the river confluence at Chojum.

days.title: Thimphu sightseeing
days.description: Visit Memorial Chorten and Tashichho Dzong viewpoints, Buddha Dordenma and the Takin reserve.

days.title: Thimphu to Punakha
days.description: Cross Dochula Pass and visit Punakha Dzong. Stay in Punakha.

days.title: Punakha to Paro
days.description: Travel to Paro and explore Paro Dzong, the airport viewpoint and town.

days.title: Chele La or Tiger’s Nest
days.description: Choose the Chele La excursion or discuss an optional Tiger’s Nest trek. Visit the museum and Kyichu Monastery as arranged.

days.title: Paro to Phuentsholing
days.description: Return to the border town, with time for shopping.

days.title: Phuentsholing to Bagdogra
days.description: Transfer to Bagdogra Airport for the return journey.

includes: Bhutan SDF charges as specified in the confirmed quote
One litre of drinking water each day
notes: Permits, SDF arrangements and required travel documents must be confirmed for your dates.
Chele La and Tiger’s Nest are alternative day options in the tour outline; trekking requirements and extra charges need confirmation.

name: Egypt with Hurghada
summary: Nine days of Cairo landmarks, a Nile cruise and time on the Red Sea coast at Hurghada.

days.title: Arrive in Cairo
days.description: Arrive in Cairo, visit the Egyptian Museum and enjoy city views from Cairo Tower as scheduled.

days.title: Alexandria excursion
days.description: Visit the Catacombs, Qaitbay Citadel exterior, Alexandria Library and Stanley Bridge. Return to Cairo.

days.title: Giza and Cairo
days.description: Explore the Giza pyramids, Sphinx and Valley Temple, with museum and shopping visits and a sound-and-light programme.

days.title: Cairo to Aswan and Nile cruise
days.description: Fly to Aswan, visit the High Dam and Unfinished Obelisk, then board the Nile cruise.

days.title: Abu Simbel and Kom Ombo
days.description: Visit Abu Simbel’s temples, then sail to Kom Ombo and explore its temple.

days.title: Edfu and Luxor
days.description: Visit the Temple of Horus in Edfu and continue towards Luxor for Karnak Temple.

days.title: Luxor to Hurghada
days.description: Disembark, visit the Valley of the Kings, Hatshepsut Temple and Colossi of Memnon, then travel to Hurghada.

days.title: Hurghada and the Red Sea
days.description: Take a dolphin-watching cruise and spend the rest of the day at leisure.

days.title: Hurghada to Cairo and departure
days.description: Return towards Cairo for your flight home.

Overseas insurance for adults up to age 60, with any age-related difference charged separately
